card.name: Spaces and links in blood-cancer dosing
card.fires_on: Small connecting spots (a space, comma, "of", "with") inside dosing and drug-interaction text for blood disorders such as polycythemia vera, thrombocythemia and myelofibrosis. It also fires partway through brand names like JAKAFI.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a week count or lab value in dose-change steps.
modes.example: • At<< >>4 weeks, increase to the maintenance dosage

modes.label: Commas in drug lists
modes.description: A comma between drug names in interaction lists.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: "of" or "with" after dose or treated, before a drug name.
modes.example: The recommended dose<< of>> BESREMi is: a starting

card.writes: It promotes runs of blank space tokens and suppresses words like tier and floor, so it mainly pushes toward whitespace.
card.plain: It marks small gaps and linking words in dosing text for blood-cell disorders and their drugs.
